audience: sales teams that write proposals and manage clients in Proposify

useCases.title: Start a proposal from a template
useCases.text: List the templates, then create a document from one of them. The document is not sent to anyone.

useCases.title: Review the documents and their status
useCases.text: List the documents with their status and dates. Then open one to read its creator and last editor.

useCases.title: Add a client to a company
useCases.text: List the companies to check for an existing one. Then create the company or the client. The server does not check for duplicates.

useCases.title: Add a reusable section to a proposal
useCases.text: List the content-library sections, then add one section to a document at a given position.

useCases.title: Archive a finished proposal
useCases.text: Find the document, then archive it. It leaves the active list. Unarchiving brings it back.

useCases.title: Set custom fields on a document
useCases.text: Read the document, then set the values of its custom fields by name. Other custom fields keep their values.
